description: Check whether an IP address really belongs to a crawler (for example one seen in server logs claiming to be Googlebot), using only what the operator documents: its published IP-range list or forward-confirmed reverse DNS. Without bot, checks every bot that has such a method. Reads the operators' public lists; never connects to the IP. verified null means it could not be decided.

bot.description: Bot token to verify against, for example Googlebot. Omit to check all. Known: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot, meta-externalagent, Bytespider, Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot, meta-externalfetcher, DuckAssistBot, Amazonbot, AhrefsBot, SemrushBot, MJ12bot, facebookexternalhit, Slackbot.

name: verify_bot_ip
